description:
0.90.0: take a folder offered to you (folder_offers). Your signature is added to the participation file
        beside the owner's: signed by both it is an agreement, kept in hashn's log (list_agreements) for both of
        you, and the folder is yours to read (or write) from then on. You do not become a member of the workspace.
        Pass `content_sha256` from folder_offers so that what is signed is the text you read. An offer you don't want
        is simply left; it can also be removed with POST /folders/{grant_id}/decline.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

content_sha256.description: The `content_sha256` folder_offers gave for the text you read, so that is what gets signed.
content_sha256.title: Content Sha256

grant_id.description: The offer's or given folder's id (a UUID), from folder_offers (or, for the owner, from the workspace's given folders).
grant_id.title: Grant Id

name: accept_folder
